race.comment: MAURRAQA (1) resumes and gets the blinkers going on today. Outclassed in a strong contest when ninth over 1300m at Eagle Farm last May. Trialled well enough to give this a shake from the good gate. PREDICT THE FUTURE (7) gets in light again with Palmer's claim after finishing a close-up seventh over 1420m at Grafton. Can hold a position and grip on late back to his preferred trip. DON'T TELLYAFATHER (5) was easily beaten at her last run before spelling and didn't fare any better when resuming over 1000m at Eagle Farm two weeks ago. Fitter and can contest for a place in this suitable race. GRACEFUL WARRIOR (11) also strips fitter second-up and is in the mix.
